description: This file is an entry point for a React-based frontend application. It imports React, ReactDOM, global CSS styles, and the main App component. It initializes the React DOM rendering process by attaching the App component to the DOM element with id 'root' within a StrictMode wrapper.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a React root for rendering the React application into the specified DOM node.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React component hierarchy into the React root.
